summary: Put by esv::swap_places::RequestSystem on the helper entity it creates for a batch of swap-places requests (the same entity gets esv::swap_places::RequestOneFrameComponent and a 0x18-element request array component); counts down 4 seconds, then the entity is destroyed. Creator bg3.exe+0x2E9F3F0 (called from bg3.exe+0x2E9E370 = ProcessSwapPlacesRequests); countdown in bg3.exe+0x2E9F130 (third step of the per-frame update bg3.exe+0x2E9DEF0; Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5D7810 RequestSystem::CleanupSwapPlacesRequests does the same). No savegame model.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E9F3F0: AllocRaw(0x10), *puVar5 = *param_2, the same handle that is the key of the component's entity map (FUN_14077e0c0(.., &entity)) - the entity the component is added to (created by FUN_14401aff0 in bg3.exe+0x2E9E370). macOS default constructor stores a 16-byte constant at +0 then 4.0f at +8 (null handle default, hint only).

fields.name: Lifetime
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E9F3F0 writes 0x40800000 (4.0f); bg3.exe+0x2E9F130 line 141: *(float*)(c+8) -= *(float*)(GameTime+8); if <= 0 the entity is destroyed (Toolkit CleanupSwapPlacesRequests the same).

fields.name: _Pad12
fields.evidence: Not written by the creator (AllocRaw memory, only +0 and +8 stored); alignment padding to 16.

open_questions: Whether +0 is really meant as a self handle or some other entity that happens to equal it at creation (only caller passes the new entity).
